readme:
# Wirecutter Product Reviews API

Extract structured product review data from Wirecutter (NYT's product review site).

## Quick Start

```bash
npm install
apify run
```

## Input

```json
{
  "mode": "single",
  "url": "https://nytimes.com/wirecutter/reviews/sony-wh-1000xm5/"
}
```

## Output

```json
{
  "id": "uuid",
  "sourceUrl": "https://nytimes.com/wirecutter/reviews/sony-wh-1000xm5/",
  "scrapedAt": "2026-04-13T12:00:00.000Z",
  "product": {
    "name": "Sony WH-1000XM5",
    "category": "Over-ear headphones",
    "subcategory": "Noise-canceling headphones"
  },
  "review": {
    "rating": 4.5,
    "price": 349.99,
    "pros": ["Excellent noise cancellation", "30-hour battery"],
    "cons": ["Expensive", "No aptX support"],
    "verdict": "The best noise-canceling headphones you can buy",
    "author": "Mark Sparrow",
    "publishedDate": "2022-10-15",
    "lastUpdated": "2026-03-01"
  }
}
```

## Modes

- `single`: Scrape a single review URL
- `category`: Scrape all reviews in a category
- `full`: Scrape all reviews across all categories

## Pricing

- Single review: $0.05
- Category scrape: $0.50
- Full catalog: $2.00

## MCP

AI agents can call this actor via MCP:

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "wirecutter-reviews": {
      "command": "npx",
      "args": ["@apify/mcp-server-wirecutter"],
      "url": "https://YOUR-USERNAME--wirecutter-product-reviews.apify.actor/mcp"
    }
  }
}
```
